title: Contract Signing Date and the Roll-In Value Figure
content:
The roll-in value figure is the value side of the negative equity a **Trade-In Agreements** roll-in into **Kestrel Auto Finance Retail Installment Contracts** is figured on. It depends on when the finance contract on the purchase the trade is applied to was signed, counted in calendar days from the contract date to the pickup date of the trade.

| Contract date compared with the pickup date | Roll-in value figure |
|---|---|
| Signed at least 7 days before pickup | The total of the agreement's value-credited entries, which leaves out the deductions found at pickup |
| Signed at least 1 day but fewer than 7 days before pickup | The agreement's original offer amount, the figure the contract was written on |
| Signed on the pickup date or later | The undistributed trade equity |

The contract date is read from the finance contract; the pickup date, the value-credited entries, the original offer amount and the undistributed trade equity from the trade-in agreement and its history.

## Boundaries (hypothetical pickup on the 15th)

| Contract date | Days before pickup | Value figure |
|---|---|---|
| The 8th | 7 | Total of value-credited entries |
| The 9th | 6 | Original offer amount |
| The 14th | 1 | Original offer amount |
| The 15th | 0 | Undistributed trade equity |
| The 16th | signed after pickup | Undistributed trade equity |

## Illustration (hypothetical figures)

Original offer $12000.00; regraded at pickup, $11000.00 credited; $400.00 of deductions posted; undistributed trade equity $10600.00 before any payoff. A contract signed 10 days before pickup is measured against $11000.00; one signed 3 days before, against $12000.00; one signed on the pickup date, against $10600.00.
